mapper.sql: FROM ast_device d INNER JOIN () candidates ON candidates.id = d.id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.sn}, '%') AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.name}, '%') AND d.product_model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.productModel}, '%') AND d.contract_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.contractNo}, '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id, d.sn, d.name, d.product_code, d.product_model, d.contract_no, d.project_id, d.customer_id, d.status
ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize}
